High-Level Platform meets in Moldova to strengthen digital connectivity between the EU and Central Asia
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Chișinău, 09 Nov 2026 Today, the first High-Level Connectivity Platform Meeting on Digital takes place in Chișinău, Moldova, jointly hosted by the European Commission and the Moldovan Ministry of Economic Development and Digitalisation. The meeting sets the groundwork for stronger digital connectivity between Europe and Centra Asia, via Moldova, in the form of an Integrated EU Secure Connectivity Offer.
